summary: Org-level deny policy prevents kms:Encrypt for dedicated onboarding agent, blocking Private deployment provisioning
description: During onboarding of a new Dedicated customer cluster for Private deployments, the automated provisioner failed at the KMS step. The flow expects to create an encrypted configuration blob using a customer-scoped CMK and call kms:Encrypt. The call is blocked by an organizational SCP that denies kms:Encrypt when requests originate from the 'infra-provisioner' principal path. Error surfaced in provisioner logs and blocked the onboarding flow.
impact: Onboarding blocked for one new Dedicated customer (private deployment). This prevents spinning up the customer's isolated infra and delays go-live. No production serving traffic affected yet, but customer-facing SRE/CSR escalation happened. Estimated delay 24-48 hours without workaround.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Trigger onboarding job: repo infra/provisioner -> pipeline run 'provision-dedicated-onboarding' for tenant 'tenant-phi'.
2) Pipeline reaches step 'encrypt-config-with-cmk' which calls AWS KMS Encrypt API with key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh.
3) Call fails with AccessDenied and org policy evaluation log indicates an SCP deny matched for action 'kms:Encrypt' on principal path 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-provisioner'.
Commands used during repro:
- aws kms encrypt --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh --plaintext fileb://config.enc --profile provisioner
- aws sts get-caller-identity --profile provisioner
logs:
Provisioner stderr excerpt:
2026-03-09T15:12:02Z ERROR kms:Encrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/infra-provisioner/session-xyz is not authorized to perform: kms:Encrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh
(org-eval-id: ORG-EVAL-2026-03-09-1)
AWS CloudTrail sample event id: 9e8f7c6a-1b2c-4dbe-99a4-0f1a2b3c4d5e
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: CMK policy restricts kms:Encrypt to a narrow principal set.
- Checked CMK key policy and found it permits account root and key-usage-role but no explicit allowance for infra-provisioner role.
- Policy simulator against the provisioner assumed-role shows org SCP deny as highest-priority decision. Example SCP snippet we found in org root: 
  {
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*"],
    "Resource": "*",
    "Condition": {"StringLike": {"aws:PrincipalTag/role": "sensitive-*"}}
  }
- Provisioner role does not carry the expected tag; it is evaluated as matching the deny due to a tag inheritance quirk introduced in recent org policy rollout.
- Temporal repro: when we ran the same encrypt call from an ad-hoc admin role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/platform-admin) it succeeded.
- Cross-check: no VPC endpoint or KMS key policy logs indicate a service-side deny; decision explicitly from org SCP evaluation.
- Eng-runbook referenced: confluence: 'private-deploy/onboarding-kms-guardrails' which notes SCPs are enforced at account eval time and will override key policies.
comments: Aisha Patel (Reporter) 2026-03-09: Customer onboarding job failed during KMS encrypt. Raising P1 because onboarding blocked.
Marco Chen (Assignee) 2026-03-09: Captured CloudTrail and org policy eval. Looks like an org SCP deny — submitting to OrgAdmins for temporary exception. Will attempt delegated-key workaround.

OrgAdminBot 2026-03-10: Confirmed org SCP 'deny-sensitive-kms' was applied 2026-02-28 as part of hardening sweep. Condition uses PrincipalTag role prefix; infra-provisioner role update planned but not yet rolled out.

Marco Chen 2026-03-10: Applied temporary workaround: created a scoped IAM role 'provisioner-kms-relay' with explicit allow for kms:Encrypt and ensured session is assumed by a short-lived admin broker which is exempt from SCP deny via tag-based exception. Tested encrypt call successful. Notified CS and left follow-up ticket to remove workaround once org policy corrected.

Security 2026-03-11: We agree short-lived workaround acceptable for one-off onboarding. Need audit trail and retention. Raised request to OrgAdmins to refine SCP condition and add explicit allow-list for our infra provisioning pipeline.
resolution:
Temporary workaround: a short-lived relay role was created to perform KMS encrypt operations and was limited to this onboarding run. The onboarding completed successfully 2026-03-11 using the relay role.
Permanent fix plan: (1) OrgAdmins to update the deny SCP to exclude the infra provisioning principal path (or require a tag pattern that the provisioner will explicitly set); (2) Update infra/provisioner to attach required PrincipalTags on assume-role sessions and add an automated validation test in the provisioning CI that simulates KMS encrypt under current org SCPs.
Follow-ups: INT-947663 (related assume-role chain failures) referenced for org policy remediation; create new RFC to add an integration test gating onboarding PRs.
